blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Scaling has become a primary driver of progress in language and vision foundation models, yet its role in precise correspondence matching remains underexplored.
In this work, we present Flow Any Scene Transformer (FAST), a scalable correspondence model driven by two key insights. First, we reveal that the query-key projections inside single-view vision foundation models encode a coarse yet reusable prior for cross-view matching.
Second, reusing these pretrained projections in cross-attention form yields a highly effective initialization for a ViT-based matcher built from a single-view encoder. Guided by these insights, we build FAST upon a vanilla single-view foundation model, utilizing a zero-parameter rewiring strategy to convert selected self-attention layers into cross-attention for cross-view interaction. This design allows ViT-based matchers to scale with advances in single-view foundation models, bypassing the need for a dedicated pair-centric pretraining stage.
To fully unlock the scaling potential of this formulation, we assemble a 6-million-pair training corpus for general-purpose dense 2D displacement estimation across diverse co-visible image pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, while scaling favorably with both backbone size and training data.
blocks.zh:
扩大规模已成为语言和愿景基础模式取得进展的主要动力,但其在精确对应方面的作用仍然没有得到充分利用。
在这部作品中,我们介绍了Flow Any Scene Transformer(FAST),这是一个由两个关键见解驱动的可伸缩的函授模型. 首先,我们揭示,单视视野基础模型内部的查询键预测编码为粗糙但可重复使用,用于交叉视图匹配.
第二,重新使用这些预先经过训练的预测,以交叉注意的形式,为用单视编码器建造的基于ViT的匹配器提供了非常有效的初始化. 以这些见解为指导,我们以香草单视基础模型为基础构建FAST,使用零参数重线策略,将选定的自留层转换成跨视交互. 这种设计使得基于ViT的配对者能够与单视基础模型的进度进行规模化,绕过一个专用的对心预训阶段的需要.
为了充分释放这种配方的放大潜力,我们收集了600万帕的培训用具,用于对各种可共见图像对的二维密度迁移情况进行通用估计。 广泛的实验表明,FAST在广泛的基准中取得了最先进的性能,同时以主干规模和培训数据进行有利的推广。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Correspondence matching is the cornerstone of many cross-view tasks, serving as a critical requirement for applications like reconstruction and navigation. Over the past decades, this task has evolved into a standardized volume-centric pipeline [ 1 ] , where view-wise representations are converted into a cost-defined hypothesis space and subsequent modules process over the resulting cost volume.
Although highly successful, this paradigm suffers a limited model scaling route, as simply stacking more aggregation or refinement blocks has shown diminishing gains [ 2 , 3 ] .
Further gains therefore rely heavily on improved module and architecture designs.
blocks.zh:
通信匹配是许多交叉视图任务的基石,是重建与导航等应用的关键要求. 在过去几十年里,这项任务已演变成一个以量为中心的标准化管道[1],将视距表示转换成一个成本界定的假设空间和随后的模块过程,以涵盖由此形成的成本量。
虽然这一模式非常成功,但模型的缩放途径有限,因为简单地堆放更多的聚合或精细区块显示收益正在减少[2、3]。
因此,进一步的进展在很大程度上依赖于改进的模块和结构设计。

blocks.en:
By contrast, recent ViT-based approaches [ 4 , 5 ] introduce a more scalable architectural paradigm, where visual representations and matching cues are progressively refined through stacked Transformer blocks.
However, scaling such models relies on pair-centric pretraining on structurally overlapping image pairs, which are not as easy to collect at scale as the independent images used by single-view ViTs.
For instance, CroCo [ 4 ] is pretrained on 5 million pairs, while DINOv3 [ 6 ] employs 1689 million images.
At the same time, recent advances [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] suggest that the output representations of single-view vision foundation models (VFMs) already exhibit strong emergent cross-image alignment capabilities, yet current pipelines still rely on additional matching modules to transform these representations into correspondences.
This observation, together with the stronger scalability of single-view pretraining, drive us to rethink: rather than initializing a ViT-based matcher from scratch through pair-centric pretraining, can it be bootstrapped from the far more scalable VFM itself?
blocks.zh:
相比之下,最近的基于VIT的方法[4,5]引入了一个更可扩展的建筑范式,通过堆叠的变形器块,视觉表现和匹配提示逐渐完善.
然而,缩放这种模型依赖于结构重叠的图像配对上的对角预训,这种预训不像单视VITs所使用的独立图像那样容易在规模上收集.
例如,Croco[4]在500万对上预先训练,而DINOv3[6]则使用1.689亿张图像.
同时,最近的进展[7,8,9]表明,单视视野基础模型(VFM)的产出表示已经显示出强烈的新兴跨图像对接能力,然而目前的管道仍然依赖额外的匹配模块来将这些表示转化为函证.
这一观察,加上单视预训更强的可伸缩性,促使我们重新思考:而不是从头开始通过对角的预训,将一个基于ViT的匹配器从头开始,而能够从更可伸缩的VFM本身的脚步开始吗?

blocks.en:
To explore this possibility, we investigate whether single-view VFMs internally encode transferable matching priors for matcher construction. Specifically, we probe this possibility by applying the query-key projections of a frozen VFM across two views.
As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the resulting attention logits concentrate on semantically corresponding regions, which inspires our first key insight: the query-key projections inside single-view VFMs encode coarse but reusable cross-view matching priors.
blocks.zh:
为了探索这种可能性,我们调查单视VFMs内部是否为匹配者构建编码可转让匹配前科. 具体地说,我们探索了这种可能性,将冻结的VFM的查询键预测运用到两种观点。
如图1所示,由此而来的关注记录集中关注成像对应的区域,这激发了我们的第一个关键洞察力:单视VFMs内部的查询键预测编码粗但可重复使用的交叉视图匹配前传.

blocks.en:
Given this finding, the next question is how to unleash the latent matching prior when adapting a pretrained single-view VFM into a matcher. Since this prior is encoded in attention projections, a natural adaptation strategy is to reuse these projections for cross-view interaction, which can be implemented with (1) explicit cross-attention between views, or (2) global self-attention over concatenated views.
Although both enable two-view interaction, they lead to drastically different behaviors at initialization.
Explicit cross-attention directs each query to the opposite view and natively establish coarse cross-view affinity before fine-tuning.
In contrast, global self-attention jointly normalizes intra- and inter-view tokens, causing self-affinity to dominate the attention mass.
This leads to our second insight: reusing pretrained projections in cross-attention form provides a structurally effective initialization for a ViT-based matcher built from a single-view VFM.
blocks.zh:
鉴于这一发现,下一个问题是如何在将预先训练过的单视VFM调整为匹配器时先释放潜在匹配. 由于这之前是用注意力预测编码的,因此自然适应战略是将这些预测重新用于交叉视图互动,执行时可以 (1) 观点之间的明确交叉视角,或者 (2) 全球自觉对凝聚观点。
虽然两者都能够实现双视交互,但它们在初始化时会导致剧烈不同的行为.
明确的交叉意向将每个查询都导向相反的观点,在微调前本土建立粗糙的交叉意向.
与此相反,全球自觉共同使视界内和视界间标志物正常化,导致自觉支配着关注量.
这引领了我们的第二个见解:以交叉注意的形式重新使用预先经过训练的预测,为用单视VFM构建的基于ViT的匹配器提供了一个结构上有效的初始化.

blocks.en:
Inspired by these insights,
we present F low A ny S cene T ransformer (FAST), a scaling-oriented correspondence model. Rather than relying on bespoke matching modules or binocular pretraining,
FAST is born on a standard single-view VFM and is adapted to dense matching through a zero-parameter rewiring strategy, which reformulates selected self-attention layers into cross-attention ones.
To complement backbone scaling with data-side scaling, we assemble a 6-million-pair corpus, a similar scale to Croco but with additional optical-flow annotations, therefore enabling task-specific adaptation after VFM-based initialization. Powered by these scalable design choices, FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks.
More importantly, FAST scales favorably with both backbone size and training data, yielding consistent gains without the early saturation observed in volume-centric approaches [ 2 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh:
受到这些见解的启发,
我们提出F 低A ny S ene T ransformer(FAST),一种面向缩放的函证模型. 而不是依赖比对模块或望远镜预训
FAST诞生在标准的单视VFM上,通过零参数重线策略适应密集匹配,将选定的自留层重排为跨留层.
为了用数据侧面的缩放来补充主干线的缩放,我们组装了600万帕,与Croco类似,但带有额外的光学流注解,从而使得在基于VFM的初始化后能够针对特定任务进行适应. 借助于这些可伸缩的设计选择,FAST实现了跨越不同基准的最先进性能.
更重要的是,FAST采用主干大小和培训数据进行有利的比例,在没有以量为中心的方法所观察到的早期饱和度[2,3]的情况下,取得一致的收益。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We reveal that the query-key projections inside single-view VFMs can be reused to produce coarse cross-view correlations, establishing the key basis for extending standard VFMs to dense matchers. • We introduce a zero-parameter attention rewiring strategy, which initializes a scalable correspondence matcher from readily available single-view VFMs. • We assemble Flow-6M, a 6-million-pair optical-flow dataset that consolidates existing flow data and converts static-scene geometry into dense flow labels. • We present FAST, a scalable correspondence foundation model that achieves strong generalization across small- and wide-baseline matching benchmarks.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Correlation-Based Method
blocks.zh: II-A 基于关联的方法

blocks.en:
Correlation-based methods leverage correlation volumes to simplify the matching problem into a regression-from-classification task.
This paradigm has been widely adopted in both optical flow and stereo matching.
blocks.zh:
基于关联的方法利用关联量将匹配问题简化为回归-从分类化的任务.
这种范式在光学流和立体匹配中都得到广泛采用.

blocks.en:
Optical Flow. Dosovitskiy et al. [ 10 ] first introduce a correlation layer to compute feature similarities for motion regression.
Building on this volume-based design, subsequent studies devote substantial effort to developing correlation aggregation strategy to recover an accurate displacement distribution from the correlation volume.
Representative directions include coarse-to-fine estimation with multi-scale correlation volumes [ 11 ] , iterative motion refinement via repeated lookups in correlation volumes [ 12 ] , and Transformer-integrated solutions [ 13 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
光学流. 多索维茨基等. [10]首先引入一个关联层来计算运动回归的特征相似性.
根据这种基于量的设计,随后的研究投入大量精力,制定相关汇总战略,从相关量中恢复准确的流离失所分布。
代表方向包括粗略到精细的估算,多尺度关联卷[11],通过对关联卷[12]的反复检索来改进迭代运动,以及变形器-综合解决方案[13,14].

blocks.en:
Stereo Matching. Stereo matching can be cast as a constrained correspondence problem where matches lie on epipolar lines.
Early learning-based methods construct a 3D cost volume of size D × H × W D\times H\times W by evaluating matching costs over discrete disparity hypotheses [ 15 ] .
This strategy is widely adopted in efficient stereo algorithms [ 16 , 17 ] due to its memory-friendly design.
Rather than compressing features into a scalar similarity, Kendall et al. [ 18 ] construct a 4D volume of size C × D × H × W C\times D\times H\times W by concatenating cross-view features along all disparity proposals, followed by 3D CNNs for cost aggregation.
Subsequent works further enrich the volume formulation and aggregation through designs such as group-wise correlation, multi-scale volumes, and attention mechanisms [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
立体声匹配. 立体声匹配可以被铸成一个受限的对应问题,因为匹配位于极地线上.
早期学习方法构建大小为D×的三维成本体积 H×W D\times H\times W通过评价匹配成本而不是离散差异假设[15].
这个策略因其便于记忆的设计,在高效的立体算法[16,17]中被广泛采用.
Kendall等人,与其将特征压缩成平面相似性。 [18] 建造大小为C×D×的4D体积. H × W C\times D\times H\times W通过在所有差异性提议上调制交叉视图功能,然后是3DCNN进行成本汇总.
随后的作品通过分组关联,多尺度体积,关注机制[19,20,21]等设计,进一步丰富了体积配制和集合.

blocks.en: Overall, although correlation volumes provide explicit correspondence hypotheses, their volume-centric formulation tightly couples matching performance with task-specific aggregation and refinement modules. Simply stacking these modules often leads to diminishing returns, limiting the scalability of correspondence models beyond architecture-specific designs.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,尽管关联量提供了明确的对应假设,但其以量为中心的配方紧紧地将性能与特定任务的汇总和完善模块相匹配. 简单地堆放这些模块往往导致回报率下降,限制了通信模型的可扩展性,超出了架构特定设计的范围.

blocks.en: II-B Correlation-Free Method
blocks.zh: II-B 无关联方法

blocks.en:
A straightforward correlation-free matching paradigm is to stack both input images together and process them through a network [ 10 ] .
This design allows the network to decide how to fuse the image pair for motion regression.
However, without an explicit cross-view interaction mechanism, such approaches typically struggle to achieve accurate motion estimation.
More recently, attention mechanisms have enabled new formulations for dense matching.
Along this line,
Li et al. [ 22 ] replace the cost volume with alternating self-attention and cross-attention along epipolar lines to aggregate cross-view evidence.
Weinzaepfel et al. [ 4 , 23 ] propose a ViT-based encoder-decoder for two-view matching, coupled with cross-view masking pretraining and dense-matching-specific fine-tuning to obtain a correlation-free model.
Building on these advances, Leroy et al. [ 24 ] introduce a local feature head to establish sparse correspondences for image matching.
Zhang et al. [ 25 ] update the single-view encoder with DINOv2 [ 26 ] and establish cross-view interaction with additional global self-attention modules.
Edstedt et al. [ 27 ] further improve the dense matching performance with frozen DINOv3, global self-attention, and cascaded warped refiners.
In parallel, recent advances [ 28 , 29 , 5 , 30 ] demonstrate the effectiveness of attention for correlation-free 3D reconstruction, but they are primarily optimized for scene-level geometry rather than precise correspondence estimation. Following this attention-based direction, we realize cross-view interaction via attention.
In contrast to prior work that designs train-from-scratch modules for dense matching, we directly leverage an existing pretrained vanilla ViT as the matcher.
blocks.zh:
一个直截了当的无关联匹配范式是将输入图像叠加在一起,并通过网络处理[10].
这种设计使得网络可以决定如何将图像配对引信用于运动回归.
然而,如果没有明确的交叉观点互动机制,这类方法通常难以实现准确的运动估计。
最近,关注机制使新的配方能够进行密集配对。
沿着这条线
李等编. [22] 将费用数额改为按极线交替自留心和交叉留心,以汇总交叉视图证据。
Weinzaepfel et al. [4,23] 提出一个基于ViT的编码器-解码器进行双视比对,同时进行交叉视掩面预训和密集比对特异性的微调,以获得无相关性模型.
在上述进展的基础上,Leroy et al. [24] 引入本地特征头来建立用于图像匹配的稀疏通信.
张等. [25] 更新使用DINOv2 [26]的单视图编码器,并与额外的全球自留心模块建立交叉视图交互.
Edstedt 等 (英语). [27]进一步提高了与冷冻的DINOv3,全球自控,以及级联扭曲精炼厂的密集匹配性能.
与此同时,最近的进步[28,29,5,30]证明了关注无相关性的3D重建的有效性,但它们主要是优化于场景级几何而非精确的函证估计. 按照这种基于关注的方向,我们通过关注实现交叉视角互动。
与先前设计列车与切换模块以进行密集匹配的工作不同,我们直接利用已有的预训香草VIT作为匹配器.

blocks.en: II-C Scaling Route for Correspondence Models
blocks.zh: II-C 扩大通信模式路线

blocks.en:
Model Scaling with Foundation Backbones . Integrating vision foundation models (VFMs) into correspondence pipelines provides a natural route for model scaling.
Along this direction, recent advances either freeze the pretrained backbones as robust encoders [ 31 , 9 , 8 ] , adapt it with parameter-efficient modules [ 32 ] , attach side-tuning branches [ 7 ] , or fully finetune the backbone [ 25 ] for downstream matching tasks.
Despite these different adaptation strategies, most methods follow an encoder-centric scaling paradigm, where VFMs are employed as single-view encoders, so that additional matching modules are still required for multi-view interaction.
As a result, increasing the VFM size mainly scales the feature extractor rather than the matching components.
In contrast, we pursue a matcher-centric scaling route by repurposing a vanilla pretrained ViT as the matching network.
blocks.zh:
模型放大与基金会背骨。 将视觉基础模型(VFM)整合到函授管道中,为模型缩放提供了一条自然路线.
沿着这个方向,最近的进展或者冻结了作为强编码器的预先训练的骨干[31,9,8],用参数效率模块调整[32],附加侧调分支[7],或者为了下游匹配任务,完全微调骨干[25].
尽管有这些不同的适应策略,但大多数方法都遵循一个编码器-以编码器为中心的缩放范式,其中VFM作为单视图编码器使用,因此多视图交互仍然需要额外的匹配模块.
因此,增加VFM的尺寸,主要是缩放特性提取器而不是匹配组件.
相比之下,我们通过重新使用一个香草经过预先训练的VIT作为匹配网络来追求一个以匹配器为中心的缩放路线.

blocks.en:
Data Scaling . Complementary to model scaling, data scaling has become another key route to improving correspondence generalization.
Weinzaepfel et al. [ 4 ] perform cross-view masked pretraining on millions of paired images to alleviate the data-hungry nature of ViT-based Croco model.
Wang et al. [ 3 ] demonstrate that motion pretraining on static scenes improves the generalization performance of optical flow estimation.
Recent efforts further enlarge the scale of labeled correspondence samples with conditional rendering [ 7 ] , depth-based warping [ 33 ] , multi-view geometric resampling [ 25 ] , and single-view homography transformations [ 34 ] .
Building on this trend, we assemble a million-scale optical flow corpus, enabling our ViT-based matcher to benefit consistently from data scaling.
blocks.zh:
数据缩放. 作为模型缩放的补充,数据缩放已成为改进函证通化的另一个关键途径.
Weinzaepfel et al. [4]对数百万对映图像进行跨视蒙面预训,以减轻基于ViT的鳄鱼模型的数据饥饿性质.
王等编. [3] 证明静态场景的运动预训能提高光学流估计的通化性能.
最近的努力进一步扩大了贴标签的函证样本的规模,有条件的渲染[7],深度的拼写[33],多视图几何重印[25],单视图的同位素变换[34].
在这一趋势的基础上,我们组装了百万个规模的光学流体,使我们的基于紫外线的匹配器能够始终如一地从数据缩放中受益。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en:
We present Flow Any Scene Transformer (FAST), a scalable dense correspondence model that transfers the scaling benefits of single-view foundation models to cross-view matching.
We first explain why a single-view pretrained VFM is effective for dense matching in Sec. III-A , then describe the rewired matching architecture in Sec. III-B .
The large-scale data corpus is introduced in Sec. III-C , and the training objectives are presented in Sec. III-D .
blocks.zh:
我们提出了Flow Any Scene Transformer(FAST),这是一种可伸缩的密集通信模型,将单视图基础模型的缩放收益转移到交叉视图匹配.
我们首先解释单视预导VFM为何在Sec. III-A中对密集匹配有效,然后在Sec. III-B中描述复线匹配架构.
第III-C节介绍了大规模数据库,第III-D节介绍了培训目标。

blocks.en: III-A Rethinking Single-View ViTs for Dense Matching
blocks.zh: III-A 重新思考单视View ViTs 用于感官匹配

blocks.en:
Recent advances [ 31 , 35 , 7 ] have demonstrated that single-view pretrained ViTs can act as robust feature extractors for dense matching.
However, within these pipelines, the matching process still relies on external correlation, followed by specialized cost aggregation and refinement modules to establish accurate correspondences.
Such a decoupled paradigm not only introduces substantial computational overhead, but also limits the network’s ability to scale in an end-to-end manner.
This limitation motivates a more fundamental question: instead of treating a pretrained ViT merely as a feature-extraction backbone, can the ViT itself serve as the matching network?
blocks.zh:
最近的进展[31、35、7]表明,单视预先训练了 ViTs可以作为强力特性提取器,用于密度匹配.
然而,在这些管道中,匹配过程仍然依赖于外部关联,随后是专门的费用汇总和完善模块,以建立准确的对应关系.
这种脱钩的范式不仅带来了大量的计算间接费用,而且限制了网络以端到端方式进行规模化的能力.
这个限制引发了一个更根本性的问题:不把预先训练过的VIT仅仅当作一个特征提取主干,VIT本身能否作为匹配网络?

blocks.en:
To answer this question, we first identify two core operations in dense matching: all-pairs correlation estimation across views, and matching evidence aggregation to resolve local ambiguities.
Fortunately, the computational substrate for both operations is inherent within the Transformer attention mechanism.
Given the query 𝐐 \mathbf{Q} and key 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , the attention logits are computed as 𝐌 = 𝐐𝐊 𝖳 / D \mathbf{M}=\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^{\mathsf{T}}/\sqrt{D} . Here, 𝐐 , 𝐊 ∈ ℝ N × D \mathbf{Q},\mathbf{K}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D} and 𝐌 ∈ ℝ N × N \mathbf{M}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times N} , where N N is the number of tokens and D D is the feature dimension.
Once the token sequence is interpreted as a flattened image grid as N = H × W N=H\times W , this inner-product formulation connects each query token to all key tokens via pairwise feature similarity, which is mathematically equivalent to constructing an all-pairs correlation volume over spatial patches.
Beyond correlation estimation, attention facilitates context-aware aggregation through value mixing, thereby integrating global cues in a manner that satisfies the requirements of matching evidence aggregation.

幸运的是,两种操作的计算基底都是变形器关注机制内固有的.

blocks.en:
Given this structural equivalence, reusing self-attention kernels for cross-view matching only requires that corresponding tokens across views stay close in the shared feature space even under viewpoint and appearance changes.
This property is naturally encouraged by large-scale pretraining, which yields representations that are both semantically stable and spatially discriminative.
Therefore, the pretrained query-key projections can be directly reused to measure cross-view token affinities without additional matching-specific initialization.
blocks.zh:
鉴于这种结构等同性,重用自留心内核进行交叉视图比对,只要求各视图中的相应符号即使在视角和外观变化下也要在共享特征空间中保持紧密.
这种财产自然受到大规模预先训练的鼓励,这种训练产生既稳定又具有空间歧视性的表述。
因此,经过预先训练的查询键预测可以直接重复使用,以测量交叉视图符号近似性,而无需额外的匹配特定初始化.

blocks.en:
To empirically validate this point, we conduct a zero-shot probing experiment.
Specifically, given a cross-view image pair { 𝐱 , 𝐲 } \{\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}\} , we pass both images through a frozen pretrained ViT, extract the projected query 𝐐 𝐱 \mathbf{Q}_{\mathbf{x}} and key 𝐊 𝐲 \mathbf{K}_{\mathbf{y}} , and manually compute the cross-attention score map as 𝐌 𝐱 ← 𝐲 cross = 𝐐 𝐱 ​ 𝐊 𝐲 𝖳 / D \mathbf{M}_{\mathbf{x}\leftarrow\mathbf{y}}^{\text{cross}}=\mathbf{Q}_{\mathbf{x}}\mathbf{K}_{\mathbf{y}}^{\mathsf{T}}/\sqrt{D} .
As visualized in Fig. 1 ,
strong attention responses frequently localize near the ground-truth corresponding regions, even though the model was never pretrained on explicit image-pair matching objectives.
At the same time, these responses are still diffuse, noisy, and often multi-modal, which makes them insufficient for precise dense correspondence estimation without task-specific adaptation.
This discrepancy indicates that while the pretrained backbone inherently possesses a useful matching prior, it requires explicit cross-view interaction and task-specific fine-tuning to achieve accurate correspondences.

blocks.en: III-B Employing ViTs as Matching Backbones
blocks.zh: III-B 使用维T作为匹配后骨

blocks.en:
Building on the finding that single-view pretrained ViTs already encode a reusable matching prior,
the next critical step is to unleash this latent cross-view compatibility
without destroying the well-established inductive biases.
To enable cross-view interaction within a Transformer block, two straightforward paradigms can be considered:
(1) concatenating the two token sequences and applying global self-attention over the union of tokens, or
(2) keeping the two token sequences separate and introducing cross-attention across views.
The crucial difference between these paradigms lies in the normalization domain of the attention logits. We formalize this distinction below.
blocks.zh:
以单景预训结论为基础 ViTs 已经编码了可重复使用的匹配前,
下一个关键步骤是释放这种潜在的交叉视图兼容性
而不破坏既定的诱导性偏见。
为了能够在变形器块内实现交叉视图交互,可以考虑两个直截了当的模式:
(1) 调和两个符号序列,并对符号结合实行全球自觉,或
(2)将两个符号序列分开,并引入跨观点的交叉注意.
这些范式之间的关键区别在于注意力记录的正常化领域。 我们将在下文正式确定这一区别。

In global self-attention,
queries from view 𝐱 \mathbf{x} attend to the concatenated token sequence [ 𝐱 ; 𝐲 ] [\mathbf{x};\mathbf{y}] , yielding attention weights as 𝐀 𝐱 ← 𝐱𝐲 global = softmax ⁡ ( [ D − 1 2 ​ 𝐐 𝐱 ​ 𝐊 𝐱 𝖳 ; D − 1 2 ​ 𝐐 𝐱 ​ 𝐊 𝐲 𝖳 ] ) , \mathbf{A}^{\mathrm{global}}_{\mathbf{x}\leftarrow\mathbf{xy}}=\operatorname{softmax}\left(\left[D^{-\frac{1}{2}}\mathbf{Q}_{\mathbf{x}}\mathbf{K}_{\mathbf{x}}^{\mathsf{T}};D^{-\frac{1}{2}}\mathbf{Q}_{\mathbf{x}}\mathbf{K}_{\mathbf{y}}^{\mathsf{T}}\right]\right), (1) where the softmax is applied jointly to both intra-view and cross-view tokens.

blocks.en: III-C Large-Scale Supervision from Static Rigid Scenes
blocks.zh: III-C 静态僵硬场景的大规模监督

blocks.en:
Beyond model scaling,
FAST also pursues data-side scaling by increasing both the number and the diversity of correspondence pairs.
Existing optical-flow datasets provide massive annotated image pairs, yet most samples are organized as video clips, where adjacent frames share repeated objects and similar scene layouts.
As a result, the large scale in pair count does not imply equally large scene-level and object-level diversity.
This motivates us to complement standard optical-flow data with additional co-visible image pairs from related geometric tasks.
blocks.zh:
除了模型缩放,
FAST也通过增加对应对的数量和多样性来实现数据侧缩放.
现有的光学流数据集提供了大量附加注释的图像对,然而大多数样本被组织成视频剪辑,相邻的帧共享重复的物体和类似的场景布局.
因此,成对计数的大规模并不意味着同样大的场景级别和对象级别的多样性.
这激励我们用相关几何任务中的额外共见图像对来补充标准光学流数据.

blocks.en:
In practice, we consolidate heterogeneous correspondence sources, including rectified stereo and SfM/SLAM reconstructions, into a unified dense 2D displacement representation.
For stereo pairs, we convert disparity into horizontal or vertical displacement by applying random 90-degree rotations.
For calibrated static rigid scenes, we employ standard multi-view geometry to induce dense correspondences from depth and camera poses.
We further apply a depth-based consistency check to improve label reliability, retaining pixels that are projected inside the target image with consistent depth geometry.
The final corpus combines optical-flow data with converted static-scene data, expanding the scale and diversity of training pairs across diverse motions, scenes, and camera configurations.
blocks.zh:
在实践中,我们把各种通信来源,包括纠正立体声和SfM/SLAM的重建,合并为统一的密集的2D流离失所代表。
对于立体对,我们通过随机的90度旋转将差异转化为水平或垂直位移.
对于校准的静态刚性场景,我们采用标准的多视几何来诱导来自深度和相机姿势的密集的通信.
我们进一步采用基于深度的一致性检查,以提高标签的可靠性,保留投射在目标图像内具有一致深度几何的像素.
最终的命题将光学流数据与转换的静态场景数据相结合,将不同运动,场景和相机配置的训练对的规模和多样性扩大.

blocks.en: IV-A Implementation
blocks.zh: 四A 执行情况

blocks.en: Training Datasets. We collect a large amount of optical flow data to facilitate learning diverse motion patterns. Besides, we convert disparity of synchronously captured stereo pairs or depth of static rigid scenes into flow format to further enrich the object and scene diversity. The collected pairs with moving objects are over 0.6 million and the total training pairs are up to 6 million (see Appendix E for more details). All training samples are grouped into three categories, including dynamic scenes, small-baseline static scenes and wide-baseline static scenes. During training, we sample uniformly across these categories.
blocks.zh: 培训数据集。 我们收集了大量的光学流数据,以便于学习不同的运动模式. 此外,我们还将同步捕获的立体对或静态刚性场景深度的差异转换成流形式,以进一步丰富物体和场景的多样性. 收集的带移动物体的对子超过60万对,培训对子总数高达600万对(详见附录E). 所有训练样本都归为三类,包括动态场景,小基线静态场景和广基线静态场景. 在培训期间,我们对这些类别进行统一抽样。

blocks.en:
Training Strategies. By default, we employ DINOv3 [ 6 ] as the backbone.
We set the total batch size equal to 16, and crop input pairs into 512 × \times 512.
Models are trained with AdamW optimizer for 1000K iterations, with a one-cycle learning-rate schedule and maximum learning rate equal to 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} .
During training, we adopt standard data augmentations [ 12 ] to increase sample diversity. Training FAST-Huge takes 8 NPUs for 10 days.
blocks.zh:
培训战略。 默认情况下,我们使用DINOv3 [6]作为骨干.
我们把总批量大小设定为16个,作物输入对为512×\时512个.
模型在1000K迭代时使用亚当W优化器进行训练,单周期学习率表和最高学习率等于1×10−4 1\Times 10×4}.
在培训期间,我们采用标准数据扩充[12],以增加样本多样性。 训练FAST-Huge需要8NPU10天.

blocks.en: IV-B Benchmark Comparison on Optical Flow Task
blocks.zh: IV-B 光学流动任务基准比较

blocks.en:
We evaluate FAST-Huge on Sintel [ 38 ] , Spring [ 39 ] , and KITTI [ 40 ] benchmarks. Different from previous methods that often rely on benchmark-specific fine-tuning or dedicated checkpoints optimized for individual datasets, FAST-Huge is evaluated with a single unified checkpoint across all benchmarks without any dataset-specific adaptation.
As shown in Table I , FAST-Huge demonstrates remarkable robustness across synthetic benchmarks. On the Sintel clean split, it achieves a state-of-the-art 0.94 EPE, improving over the previous best result by 12.1%. On Spring, FAST-Huge delivers the lowest EPE, 1PE and F1 scores among all compared methods.
Notably, FAST-Huge outperforms CrocoFlow across all metrics on Sintel and Spring, demonstrating the effectiveness of our scalable backbone and large-scale correspondence supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们评价FAST-Huge在Sintel[38],Spring[39],以及KITTI[40]基准. FAST-Huge不同于以往常常依赖针对具体基准的微调或为单个数据集优化的专用检查站的方法,在对所有基准进行统一检查站评价时,没有针对数据集的任何调整。
如表一所示,FAST-Huge显示出不同合成基准的显著强性。 在Sintel净分裂上,它实现了最先进的0.94 EPE,比以前的最佳结果提高了12.1%。 在春季,FAST-Huge在所有比较方法中提供最低的EPE,1PE和F1分数.
值得注意的是,FAST-HUGE业绩优异 鳄鱼 跨越辛特尔和斯普林的所有度量衡 证明了我们可扩展的骨干和大规模通信监管的有效性

blocks.en:
On KITTI, FAST-Huge achieves competitive F1-background performance under zero-shot evaluation.
The remaining performance gap mainly originates from foreground motion estimation, where FAST is less effective for large out-of-image motions (Fig. 5 ).
Meanwhile, FAST produces sharper and better aligned motion boundaries, while such improvements are not fully reflected by KITTI metrics due to imperfect annotations around object boundaries [ 41 ] .
Further increasing the diversity of dynamic scenes in training data and introducing sim-to-real self-supervised objectives may help mitigate this gap.
Overall, these results highlight that FAST-Huge generalizes well across diverse flow benchmarks without task-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
在KITTI上,FAST-Huge在零镜头评价下实现了具有竞争力的F1背景性能.
其余的性能差距主要源于前缘运动估计,FAST对于大型的外缘运动不太有效(图5).
同时,FAST产生更尖锐,更对齐的运动边界,而由于对象边界周围的注释不完善[41],这种改进并没有被KITTI的度量衡充分反映.
在培训数据方面,进一步增加动态场景的多样性,并引入自控目标,可能有助于缩小这一差距。
总的来说,这些结果突出表明,FAST-Huge在不进行具体任务的微调的情况下,对各种流动基准作了很好的概括。

blocks.en: IV-C Zero-shot Evaluation on Stereo Matching Task
blocks.zh: 关于立体声匹配任务的零镜头评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate the zero-shot stereo matching capability of FAST-Huge on four standard benchmarks: KITTI 2012 & 2015 [ 45 , 40 ] , ETH3D [ 46 ] , and Middlebury [ 47 ] . Specifically, we compare FAST-Huge with optical-flow methods that are enhanced by large-scale pretraining or finetuning, including FlowFormer++ [ 42 ] (video pretraining on YouTube-VOS [ 48 ] ), CrocoFlow [ 23 ] (masked pretraining on 5.4M cross-view pairs), Flow-Anything [ 33 ] (motion finetuning on FA-Flow with 6M images), and PanMatch [ 9 ] (motion finetuning on 1.8M pairs).
This comparison assesses the task-transfer capability of general correspondence models from optical flow estimation to stereo matching.
As listed in Table II , FAST-Huge outperforms existing optical-flow baselines across benchmarks, with the error rate reducing 9% on KITTI15, 9% on KITTI12 and 31% on ETH3D.
blocks.zh:
我们根据四个标准基准评价FAST-Huge的零镜头立体匹配能力:KITTI 2012 & 2015 [45,40],ETH3D [46],和Middlebury [47]. 具体来说,我们比较FAST-Huge与通过大规模预训或微调增强的光学流法,包括FlowFormer++[42](YouTube-VOS[48]上的视频预训),CrocoFlow[23](对5.4M跨视对进行大规模预训),Flow-Anything [33](对FA-Flow进行6M图像的移动微调),以及PanMatch[9](对1.8M对进行移动微调).
这一比较评估了一般通信模型从光学流估计到立体匹配的任务转移能力.
如表二所列,FAST-Huge超越了现有光学流基线,误差率在KITTI15上降低9%,在KITTI12上降低9%,在ETH3D上降低31%。

blocks.en:
We additionally report stereo matching models trained on million-scale stereo pairs as reference. Note that these methods explicitly exploit stereo geometry through components such as epipolar-constrained matching and warping-based refinement. Despite equipping without these designs, FAST-Huge outperforms Selective-IGEV on all four benchmarks, and surpasses MatchAttention-B on KITTI 2015 and ETH3D.
Notably, FAST-Huge approaches FoundationStereo on the two KITTI benchmarks, with the absolute D1-all gaps only 0.21 on KITTI 2012 and 0.17 on KITTI 2015.
Although FAST still lags behind on ETH3D and Middlebury with the hard 1pe and 2pe metrics, its scaling-oriented trends observed in Section 4.5 suggest that broader supervision and stronger backbones may further narrow the residual gap.
blocks.zh:
我们额外报告立体匹配模型 训练了百万级立体对作为参考。 请注意,这些方法通过诸如极性紧凑的配对和以曲折为基础的改进等组件,明确利用立体几何学. 尽管装备没有这些设计,但FAST-Huge在所有四个基准上都超越了Selective-IGEV,并在KITTI 2015和ETH3D上超越了MatchAtention-B.
值得注意的是,FAST-Huge在KITTI的两个基准上接近FoundationStereo,2012年KITTI的绝对D1-全部差距只有0.21,2015年KITTI的0.17.
虽然FAST在ETH3D和Middlebury方面仍然落后于硬的1pe和2pe度量衡,但第4.5节中观察到的面向规模的趋势表明,更广泛的监督和更强大的骨干可能进一步缩小剩余差距。

blocks.en: IV-D Wide-Baseline Benchmark Comparison
blocks.zh: 广域基准比较

blocks.en:
The stereo and optical-flow evaluations mainly focus on small-baseline scenarios, where viewpoint changes are relatively limited.
To further verify whether FAST can serve as a general-purpose dense correspondence model, we additionally evaluate it under wide-baseline settings.
Specifically, we consider two evaluation protocols.
First, we directly measure dense matching accuracy on DTU [ 49 ] and TA-WB [ 25 ] , and compare FAST with representative general matching methods [ 9 , 25 , 27 ] .
Second, we evaluate relative pose estimation on WxBS [ 50 ] , ScanNet [ 51 ] , and MegaDepth [ 52 ] , where reliable camera pose recovery requires geometrically consistent matches under significant viewpoint and appearance variations.
Note that FAST’s results are obtained with the same checkpoint, without dataset-specific fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
立体和光学流评价主要侧重于小基线假想,观点变化相对有限。
为了进一步核实FAST是否能够作为通用的密集通信模型,我们在宽基线设置下进一步评价它.
具体地说,我们考虑了两项评价议定书。
首先,我们在DTU[49]和TA-WB[25]上直接测量密度匹配精度,并将FAST与代表性的一般匹配方法[9,25,27]进行比较.
第二,我们评价WxBS[50]、ScanNet[51]和Mega Depth[52]的相对估计,其中可靠的相机构成恢复,需要在显著的视角和外观变化下进行几何一致的匹配。
请注意,FAST的结果是在同一个检查站取得的,没有针对数据集的微调.

blocks.en:
Evaluation on Dense Matching. We first compare FAST with UFM, a related ViT-DPT model augmented with 12 Transformer blocks and a refiner for matching.
As shown in Table. III , FAST outperforms UFM on all eight metrics, reducing EPE from 5.55 to 4.43 on DTU and from 12.84 to 12.03 on TA-WB.
Compared with RoMav2 which employs cascaded refiners, FAST achieves the lowest EPE metric on DTU and trails by only 0.7 and 3.2 percentage points under the 5pe criterion on DTU and TA-WB, respectively.
Together with Table I & II , these appended evidence suggest that FAST handles dense 2D correspondence across both small- and wide-baseline settings.

Relative Pose Estimation. We further evaluate FAST on pose estimation benchmarks, where accurate pose recovery requires reliable correspondences together with effective visibility/confidence estimates for filtering ambiguous matches.
As reported in Table IV , FAST achieves a second-best rank on the challenge WxBS benchmark, surpassing RoMav2 by 19.1 points.
FAST also obtains the second-best AUC@5 ∘ /10 ∘ metric on ScanNet.
On MegaDepth, it consistently outperforms UFM under the same zero-shot setting, improving AUC@5 ∘ /10 ∘ /20 ∘ from 41.5/57.9/72.4 to 48.5/65.7/79.1.
These results provide a stringent task-level verification of the accuracy and geometric consistency of FAST’s dense matches.

如表四所示,FAST在挑战WxBS基准上取得了第二佳成绩,比RoMav2高19.1分.
FAST也在ScanNet上获得第二佳的AUC@5 QQ/10 QQ 度量衡.

这些结果为FAST密集匹配的准确性和几何一致性提供了严格的任务级核查.

blocks.en: IV-E Ablation Study
blocks.zh: IV-E 读取研究

blocks.en:
We conduct comprehensive ablation studies to validate: (1) the benefits of single-view pretraining for dense matching; (2) the superiority of our rewired cross-attention over global self-attention; (3) the decoder role; (4) the effect of trainable parameter scale; and (5) the scaling behavior with respect to both model size and training data.
We use DINOv3-Large as the backbone and train it on a combination of the SceneFlow, TartanAir, and Virtual KITTI 2 datasets for 1,000K iterations with a batch size of 8.
We evaluate the zero-shot performance on the training splits of Middlebury, ETH3D, Sintel, and KITTI-15 datasets. Results are summarized in Table V .
blocks.zh:
我们进行全面的减值研究,以验证:(1) 单视预试对密集匹配的好处;(2) 我们的重联交叉意向优于全球自觉;(3) 解码器的作用;(4) 可训练参数尺度的影响;(5) 模型大小和培训数据方面的缩放行为。
我们使用DINov3-Large作为骨干,并在SceneFlow,TartanAir和虚拟KITTI 2数据集的组合上对其进行训练,用于1000K重联,批量大小为8个.
我们评价了Middlebury、ETH3D、Sintel 和KITTI-15数据集的零射效绩。 成果摘要见表五。

blocks.en:
Scalable Pretraining Initialization. Large-scale single-view pretraining is the cornerstone of FAST. As shown in Table V , training the ViT backbone from scratch drastically degrades generalization, indicating that pretraining is essential for modeling precise correspondence.
Furthermore, upgrading the initialization from DINOv2-Large (pretrained on 142M images) to DINOv3-Large (pretrained on 1.6B images) yields consistent performance improvements across all metrics.
These results demonstrate that FAST effectively inherits the scaling benefits of single-view pretraining, where larger-scale pretrained representations provide increasingly stronger initialization for dense matching.
blocks.zh:
可缩放预训初始化. 大规模单景预训是FAST的基石. 如表五所示,从零开始培训ViT主干线将大大降低通俗化,表明预训对模拟准确的通信至关重要。
此外,将初始化从DINov2-Large(在142M图像上预先训练)升级到DINov3-Large(在1.6B图像上预先训练),使所有衡量标准都取得了一致的性能改进。
这些结果显示,FAST有效地继承了单景预训的缩放效益,其中规模更大的预训表现为密集匹配提供了越来越强的初始化.

blocks.en:
Cross-view Interaction. We compare our rewired cross-attention against global self-attention for two-view interaction.
Although global self-attention also enables effective cross-view interaction and achieves competitive matching performance, replacing it with rewired cross-attention consistently reduces estimation errors across all evaluation metrics. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-view affinities through cross-attention is better aligned with correspondence matching than jointly modeling intra- and inter-view interactions with global self-attention.
blocks.zh:
跨视互动. 我们把重联的交叉意向与全球对双视互动的自我意向相比较。
虽然全球自觉性也能够进行有效的交叉视图互动,并实现竞争性匹配性能,但取而代之的是重新连接的交叉自觉性,不断减少所有评价指标的估计错误。 这些结果表明,通过交叉意向明确模拟交叉视向的亲和性,比联合模拟与全球自我意向的相互内和相互间互动更符合函证匹配性.

blocks.en: Furthermore, to examine whether the attention rewiring mechanism preserves the pretrained ViT’s inductive bias at initialization, we visualize the last-layer representations and attention responses before and after rewiring. As shown in Fig. 6 , despite significant cross-view variations caused by object motion and appearance changes, the PCA structures and correspondence-related attention patterns remain consistent after converting self-attention into cross-attention. This observation suggests that the matching prior encoded in DINOv3 is preserved during the transition from single-view perception to correspondence matching.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了检查注意力再接合机制是否保留了ViT在初始化时被预先训练的诱导性偏差,我们在重接之前和之后可以想象到最后一层的表达和注意力反应。 如图6所示,尽管物体运动和外观变化造成了显著的交叉视图变化,但PCA结构和函证相关关注模式在将自留心转换为交叉视角后仍然保持一致. 这一观察表明,DINOv3中之前编码的匹配在从单视图感知到函证匹配的过渡过程中被保留.

blocks.zh: 图6:原线与复线的DINOv3-Huge(从总32层的第15层重线)的末层比较.

blocks.en: Decoder Role. To identify whether the learned correspondence is encoded in the rewired ViT or depends on the decoder capacity, we start from a trained FAST, replace its DPT (44M params.) with a linear head (1.4M params.), freeze the ViT backbone and train only the new head. As shown in Table V , despite 31 × \times compression in parameters, Linear-Swap variant increases EPE by only 0.09 – 0.88 pixels. This modest degradation indicates that correspondence is decodable from the frozen ViT representations rather than memorized by DPT. The remaining performance gap mainly comes from DPT’s stronger multi-level decoding and sub-pixel refinement capabilities.
blocks.zh: 解码器角色. 为了辨别所学的函文是编解码于复线VIT还是取决于解码能力,我们从训练有素的FAST开始,用线头(1.4Mparms.)取代其DPT(44Mparms.),冻结VIT主干线,只训练新头. 如表五所示,尽管参数压缩了31×x\times, Linear-Swap 变体只增加了0.09–0.88像素. 这种轻微的退化表明,信件可以从冻结的ViT表述中解码,而不是由DPT记住. 其余的性能差距主要来自于DPT更强大的多级解码和子像素精密能力.

blocks.en:
Parameter-Efficient Adaptation. We compare full fine-tuning with LoRA-based adaptation to investigate whether FAST relies on full backbone fine-tuning to acquire dense matching capability.
As shown in Table V , LoRA with r = 16 r=16 reduces the trainable ViT parameters from 384M to only 4M.
Nevertheless, LoRA adaptation still yields strong zero-shot performance, and further approaches the fully fine-tuned counterpart when increasing the rank from 16 to 64. This result suggests that the transferred dense matching ability mainly comes from the pretrained ViT representations and the rewired cross-attention formulation, rather than from unconstrained parameter updates.
blocks.zh:
参数有效适应. 我们把完全微调与基于LORA的适应进行比较,以调查FAST是否依赖于完全骨干微调以获得密集匹配能力.
如表V所示,r=16r=16的LORA将可列车的VIT参数从384M减少到仅4M.
尽管如此,LORA的适应仍然能产生强烈的零射性能,并且在将级别从16名提高到64名时,进一步接近经过充分调整的对应方。 这一结果表明,转移的密集匹配能力主要来自预先训练的ViT表示和重联的交叉意向配方,而不是来自不受约束的参数更新.

blocks.en: Model Scalability. To evaluate model scalability, we instantiate FAST with DINOv3 backbones of increasing sizes: Base, Large, and Huge. As shown in Table V , performance improves across all zero-shot benchmarks as the model scale increases. Notably, we observe no performance saturation within the evaluated range, indicating that FAST effectively inherits the scaling properties of foundation models, translating larger pretrained ViTs into proportionally stronger dense matching capabilities.
blocks.zh: 型号可伸缩性. 为了评估模型的可扩展性,我们用DINov3的骨干将FAST即时化:基、大和大。 如表五所示,随着模型比额表的增加,所有零射线基准的业绩都有所改善。 值得注意的是,我们观察到评价范围内没有性能饱和,这表明FAST有效继承了基础模型的缩放属性,将更大的预先训练的ViTs转化为比例上更强的密集匹配能力.

blocks.en:
Data Scalability. We explore data scalability by training FAST on progressively larger datasets:
FlyingThings3D (0.07M samples),
a mixture of SceneFlow, TartanAir, and Virtual KITTI 2 (0.5M samples),
Flow-Dynamic (0.6M dynamic-scene pairs),
and Flow-6M (Flow-Dynamic augmented only with static-scene pairs).
Results in Table 5 support two conclusions.
First, performance improves overall as the training corpus scales from 0.07M to 6M pairs, confirming that FAST benefits effectively from data scaling.
Second, augmenting Flow-Dynamic solely with static-scene pairs improves all reported metrics, including those on the dynamic Sintel and KITTI-15 benchmarks.
This demonstrates that static-scene supervision strengthens geometric matching priors that transfer to independent object motion.
blocks.zh:
数据可缩放性. 我们通过培训FAST逐步扩大数据集,探索数据的可扩展性:
飞行图3D(0.07M样本),
由SceneFlow、TartanAir和Virtual KITTI 2(0.5M样品)组成的混合物,
flow-Dynamic(0.6M动态场景对),,
和Flow-6M(只用静态成对放大的Flow-Dynamic).
表5中的结果支持两个结论。
首先,随着培训教材从0.07M对增加到6M对,业绩总体上有所改善,证实FAST有效地受益于数据缩放。
第二,仅用静电成对增强流动动态,改进了所有报告的指标,包括动态Sintel和KITTI-15基准的指标。
这表明静电-场景监督加强了向独立物体运动转移的几何匹配前缀.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
We reveal that single-view VFMs encode transferable cross-view matching priors, which can be effectively reused in cross-attention form through zero-parameter attention rewiring.
Building on this finding, we introduce FAST, a scaling-oriented correspondence model built from DINOv3.
We further assemble Flow-6M to support data-side scaling.
Extensive experiments show that FAST achieves state-of-the-art performance across benchmarks, while scaling favorably with both backbone capacity and training data.
blocks.zh:
我们揭示,单视VFM编码可转让交叉视图匹配前缀,可以通过零参数的注意力重焊,以交叉视线形式有效再利用.
基于这一发现,我们引入了FAST,一种由DINOv3构建的面向规模的函证模型.
我们进一步组装Flow-6M,以支持数据侧缩放.
广泛的实验表明,FAST实现了跨越基准的最先进业绩,同时以主干能力和培训数据进行有利的推广。

blocks.en: Appendix C Architecture Comparison
blocks.zh: 附录C 比较

blocks.en: We summarize the architectural compositions of representative ViT-based correspondence models in Table VI . Existing approaches typically employ a pretrained image encoder followed by an additional parameterized module for cross-view interaction. For instance, CroCo v2 [ 4 , 23 ] adopts a Base scale ViT as the cross-attention decoder on top of a ViT-L encoder, while UFM [ 25 ] and RoMa v2 [ 27 ] introduce additional Transformer blocks to exchange information between independently extracted foundation-model features. In contrast, FAST establishes cross-view interaction directly within the pretrained backbone by rewiring selected self-attention layers into cross-attention. This design reuses the pretrained attention projections as matching modules and therefore introduces zero additional parameters for cross-view interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们总结表六中具有代表性的基于VIT的函证模型的建筑组成。 现有方法通常使用经过预先训练的图像编码器,然后是用于交叉视图互动的附加参数化模块。 例如,CroCo v2 [4, 23] 采用了一个 Base scale Vit作为一个ViT-L编码器顶部的交叉意向解码器,而UFM [25] 和 RoMa v2 [27] 引入了额外的变形器块,以便在独立提取的基建模型特性之间交换信息. 相比之下,FAST通过将选定的自留心层重新连接到交叉留心中,在预训骨干内部直接建立交叉视图交互. 这种设计再利用预先训练的注意力预测作为匹配模块,因此引入了零附加的交叉视图交互参数.

blocks.en: Appendix D Qualitative Comparison and Downstream Application
blocks.zh: 附录D 定性 比较和下游应用程序

blocks.en:
In this section, we provide additional qualitative comparisons to complement the quantitative evaluations in the main paper. We consider increasingly challenging correspondence settings, ranging from optical flow and rectified stereo matching to wide-baseline image matching, and finally evaluate FAST as a correspondence front-end for multi-view 3D reconstruction.
Unless otherwise specified, all FAST results are produced using the same unified FAST-Huge checkpoint without benchmark-specific fine-tuning or adaptation.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们提供额外的质量比较,以补充主要文件中的定量评价。 我们考虑越来越具有挑战性的函证设置,从光学流和修正立体匹配到宽基线图像匹配,最后评价FAST是多视图3D重建的函证前端.
除非另有说明,所有FAST结果均使用同一统一的FAST-Huge检查站生产,不进行具体基准的微调或调整.

blocks.en: D-A Qualitative Comparison on Optical Flow
blocks.zh: D-A 光学流质量比较

blocks.en:
We first compare FAST with CroCo-Flow [ 23 ] and SEA-RAFT [ 3 ] on the Sintel [ 38 ] and Spring [ 39 ] benchmarks.
CroCo-Flow provides a particularly relevant comparison, as both methods follow a ViT-based dense prediction paradigm with a DPT head.
However, CroCo-Flow relies on dedicated cross-view pretraining to initialize its binocular architecture, whereas FAST directly repurposes a pretrained single-view ViT as the matching backbone through attention rewiring, without requiring cross-view pretraining.
We additionally include SEA-RAFT as a representative correlation-based optical-flow method, providing a complementary comparison with a specialized flow architecture.
blocks.zh:
我们首先将FAST与CroCo-Flow[23]和SEA-RAFT[3]在Sintel[38]和Spring[39]基准上进行比较.
CroCo-Flow提供了特别相关的比较,因为这两种方法都遵循一个基于VIT的密集预测范式,带有一个DPT头.
然而,CroCo-Flow依靠专用的交叉视图前置训练来初始化其双视架构,而FAST则直接重新使用一个经过预先训练的单视VIT作为匹配的骨干,通过注意力再接,无需交叉视图前置训练.
此外,我们还把SEA-RAFT作为一种具有代表性的基于相关性的光学流动方法,提供了与专门流动结构的补充比较。

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 7 , FAST exhibits clear advantages in challenging motion regions. On Sintel, FAST better handles large occluded regions and produces a more spatially coherent flow field, reducing the overall EPE to 4.423, compared with 6.403 for CroCo-Flow and 8.835 for SEA-RAFT.
On Spring, FAST produces sharper and better image-aligned motion boundaries, particularly along the highlighted foreground contour, while exhibiting noticeably lower errors over the background region. These results suggest that FAST not only improves overall matching accuracy, but also better preserves motion discontinuities in challenging high-resolution scenes.
blocks.zh:
如图7所示,FAST在挑战运动区域中表现出明显的优势. 在Sintel上,FAST较好地处理大面积的渗漏区域,并产生更空间一致的流场,将总体的EPE减少到4.423,而CroCo-Flow和SEA-RAFT分别为6.403和8.835.
在春季,FAST产生更尖锐,更好的图像对齐运动边界,特别是沿着突出的前缘轮廓,同时在背景区域上显示出明显的较低误差. 这些结果表明,FAST不仅提高了整体匹配的准确性,而且在挑战性高分辨率场景中也更好地保留了运动不连续性.

blocks.en: D-B Zero-shot Generalization on Stereo Matching
blocks.zh: D-B 立体声比对上的零射一般化

blocks.en:
We next compare FAST with S 2 M 2 [ 41 ] and FoundationStereo [ 7 ] , two recent state-of-the-art stereo matching methods.
Unlike these stereo-specialized models, FAST directly transfers its generic 2D correspondence capability to rectified stereo matching without relying on stereo-specific cost-volume reasoning.
As shown in Fig. 8 , FAST remains robust in challenging Booster scenes where both specialized methods exhibit noticeable local failures.
In the first example, FAST recovers a spatially coherent disparity field with substantially lower errors.
For the transparent object, S 2 M 2 and FoundationStereo suffer from background-disparity leakage through the surface, whereas FAST produces a smoother and more coherent disparity estimate with fewer errors inside the transparent region.
These results demonstrate that the generic correspondence formulation of FAST transfers effectively to challenging stereo scenes and provides complementary robustness beyond stereo-specific designs.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来比较FAST与S 2 M 2 [41] 和 FoundationStereo [7] 两个最新最先进的立体匹配方法.
与这些立体专用模型不同,FAST直接转移其通用的2D通信能力来修正立体匹配,而不依赖于立体特定的成本量推理.
如图8所示,FAST在具有挑战性的“助推器”场景中仍然很活跃,这两种专门方法都显示出明显的局部失败。
在第一个例子中,FAST恢复了一个空间连贯的差幅场,误差大大降低.
对于透明物体,S 2 M 2 和 FoundationStereo 发生背景差渗漏,而FAST 则产生更平滑、更一致的差值估计,透明度区域内的错误较少。
这些结果表明,FAST的通用函式配方有效地向挑战立体声场景转移,并提供了超出立体声特定设计的补充强性.

blocks.en: D-C Wide-baseline Dense Matching
blocks.zh: D- C 宽底线调试

blocks.en: We further evaluate FAST on WxBS [ 50 ] against RoMa [ 8 ] , RoMa v2 [ 27 ] , and UFM [ 25 ] , three recent state-of-the-art dense correspondence methods. As shown in Fig. 9 , the evaluated pairs cover extreme appearance variations, including seasonal changes, day–night transitions, and cross-modal RGB–infrared matching. RoMa and RoMa v2 often produce sparse warps with large low-confidence regions, while UFM provides denser predictions but fails to recover reliable correspondences in Scene 2. In contrast, FAST consistently produces more complete and structurally coherent warps with fewer spurious correspondences. The advantage is particularly pronounced for RGB–infrared matching, where FAST preserves most of the scene structure despite the substantial modality gap. These results demonstrate a favorable balance between correspondence completeness and outlier suppression, highlighting the generalization capability of FAST beyond conventional flow and stereo settings.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评估FAST在WxBS [50] 针对罗马 [8],罗马 v2 [27],以及UFM [25],三种最新最新最先进的密集通信方法. 如图9所示,被评价的对子包括极端的外观变化,包括季节变化、日夜过渡和跨模式的RGB红外匹配。 RoMa和RoMa v2经常产生具有较大低信心区域的稀疏的曲速,而UFM则提供更密集的预测,但未能在第2场中恢复可靠的通信. 相比之下,FAST则以较少的虚假通信方式,不断生产更完整,结构一致的曲柄. 对于RGB-红外线匹配来说,这一优势特别明显,FAST尽管模式缺口很大,但仍保留了大部分场景结构. 这些结果表明,在通信完整性和外部压制之间取得了有利的平衡,突出了FAST超出常规流量和立体设置的通用能力。

blocks.en:
We further evaluate FAST as a correspondence and depth-estimation component in a complete 3D reconstruction pipeline following [ 9 ] .
To isolate the effect of FAST from image retrieval, we first compare it with the standard COLMAP pipeline under an identical image-pair graph. Only the pair identities are shared: COLMAP uses SIFT correspondences followed by PatchMatch stereo [ 79 ] , whereas FAST independently predicts correspondences, estimates camera poses through SfM and bundle adjustment, triangulates dense depth from flow, and produces the final fused point cloud. We additionally evaluate an exhaustive FAST variant that removes the COLMAP pairing prior and processes every unordered image pair. As shown on the ETH3D Courtyard scene (Fig. 10 ), the standard COLMAP reconstruction contains a substantial number of flying points, whereas both FAST variants produce visibly cleaner geometry. FAST with exhaustive pairing further improves point-cloud density and scene completeness over the variant restricted to the COLMAP-derived pair graph. This indicates that the dense correspondences predicted by FAST can exploit additional cross-view constraints that are not retained by the conventional pair-selection stage.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价FAST作为[9]之后一个完整的3D重建管道中的通信与深度估计部分.
为了将FAST的效果从图像检索中分离出来,我们首先在相同的图像-pair图下将其与标准COLMAP管道进行比较. 只有对偶身份是共享的:COLMAP使用SIFT通信,PatchMatch立体声后继[79],而FAST则独立预测对应,估计相机通过SfM和捆绑调整,三角从流中分解密度深度,并产生最终的引信点云. 我们还对一个详尽无遗的FAST变体进行了评价,该变体取消了COLMAP的配对,并处理每个无序图像配对. 如ETH3D Courtyard场景所示(图10),标准COLMAP重建包含大量飞行点,而两个FAST变体都会产生明显的更清洁的几何. FAST的详尽配对进一步提高了点云密度和场景完整性,超过了仅限于COLMAP衍生的配对图的变体. 这表明FAST预测的密集的函证可以利用常规对偶选择阶段所不保留的更多交叉视图限制.

blocks.en: On the T&T Family scene with long trajectory (Fig. 11 ), FAST-COLMAP again produces substantially fewer floating artifacts than standard COLMAP. Compared with recent feed-forward reconstruction approach like DA3 [ 30 ] , FAST recovers finer geometric structures, particularly the silhouette and local details of the human figure, while also preserving more complete scene coverage. DA3 reconstructs the dominant scene structure but tends to produce smoother and less detailed geometry. These qualitative results demonstrate that FAST can provide accurate correspondences for both camera-pose recovery and dense reconstruction, yielding clean and detailed point clouds without relying on COLMAP pose or depth estimates.
blocks.zh: 在具有长轨的T&T Family场景(图11)上,FAST-COLMAP再次产生的漂浮文物比标准COLMAP少得多. 与DA3 [30] 等近期的饲料前进重建方法相比,FAST恢复了更细微的几何结构,特别是人类人物的淤泥和局部细节,同时也保留了更完整的场景覆盖. DA3重建了占优势的场景结构,但倾向于产生更平滑,更不详细几何. 这些定性结果显示,FAST可以为摄像头的恢复和密集重建提供准确的对应数据,产生干净详细的点云,而无需依赖COLMAP的浮点数或深度估计.
